resources.string: Open Maps for the next leg
Tap to start navigation to the next stops
Read addresses from screenshots, order the stops and start navigation with Swedish announcements.
You can also share a screenshot from any app directly to Nästa Stopp.
No addresses found in the images
If this happens again, take a screenshot of this message and send it to the developer. The text above contains no addresses.
The address list will be permanently deleted.
Drag ☰ to reorder • swipe to delete • tap to edit • long-press for more
The route and its list are deleted. Its trips stay under \"Previous trips\" on Home until their time runs out (see Settings) or you clear them. Google Maps keeps navigating until you close it there.
Tap Next when you leave a stop

Location is used only while a route is active, to show and say the street you are on (the floating button\'s circle and the route screen). It is never stored, logged or sent, it never moves the route on by itself, and the YouDrive page never gets it (location is switched off for that page). Choose \"While using the app\".

Privacy: images are read on the phone only and never stored. Only times, addresses, the trip kind and the passenger\'s first and last name (shown on your screens only) are kept; the route list is deleted when the route ends, when you clear, or after 12 hours, and finished trips stay in the history for the chosen time (12 hours by default). The app uses the internet only for your YouDrive page, the street map download you start, and the passenger display\'s weather (SMHI, for a fixed place, Karlstad); it sends no data of yours anywhere; no analytics. With your permission it reads only Google Maps\' navigation notification, for the travel time on the passenger display. Location (if you allow it) only names the street you are on during a route; it is never stored or sent, and the YouDrive page never gets it. The YouDrive login stays on this phone and can be deleted.

So that Samsung does not stop the app while driving:

1. Open Settings → Battery and device care → Battery.
2. Choose Background usage limits.
3. Open "Never sleeping apps", tap + and pick Nästa Stopp.
4. Turn off "Put unused apps to sleep" or make sure the app is not listed as sleeping / deep sleeping.
5. In App info → Battery choose Unrestricted.
6. You can also lock the app in the recent apps list.

Announcements are always in Swedish.

1. Tap "Install Swedish voice", choose Swedish (Sweden) and download it.
2. On Samsung: Settings → General management → Text-to-speech → Preferred engine → choose Speech Services by Google.
3. Come back and tap "Test voice" in Settings.
Share a screenshot to the app

1. Take a screenshot of the page with the addresses (any app: dispatch app, SMS, email, web page). Use scroll capture for long lists.
2. Tap Share in the screenshot toolbar or in the gallery and pick Nästa Stopp. Several images are fine; they are added in order.
3. Or open the app and tap "Import screenshots".
4. Review the list and tap "Start route". Google Maps opens with the stops (up to 10 at a time).

If you allow "display over other apps", a floating card of smoked glass is shown over Google Maps during the route:
• The wide bar at the top = the street you are on now, with location allowed (without it: the next stop's area). Tap it to hear it; its speaker button turns saying each new street by itself on and off. Beside it, in its own circle: the car's speed (km/h).
• Below it, the next trip: its time with the stop's street and number beside it (tap them to hear them), the passenger and how early or late (green = plenty of time, yellow = soon, red = late), then the town. The stripe on its side has the trip's YouDrive colour. Tap the rest to open the app.
• "Next" = next stop + announcement (long-press = repeat the announcement).
• "Back" = undo the last "Next".
• "–" = shrink it to a small capsule (tap it to expand). "×" = close; bring it back from the notification or the Quick Settings tile.
• Drag it to move it.
Without it everything works from the notification.

When you tap Next (in the app, on the floating button or in the notification) the app announces the next stop and the one after it in Swedish, e.g. \"Nästa stopp: Storgatan 14, Skoghall, Hammarö. Därefter: Kungsgatan 5, Kil.\"\nThe next stop is said with its street and number, then its district and town; the one after it with its street and number and district (Settings can make both shorter). A passenger\'s name is never said.\nIf you allow location, the app uses it only to name the street you are on; YouDrive\'s page never gets it.

The app reads addresses from screenshots – on the phone only – builds a list of stops, opens Google Maps and announces the next stop and the one after it in Swedish so passengers know the order.

The app does not use the internet, stores no images and deletes the addresses when the route is done.

We will now ask for the permissions one at a time.
During a route a notification shows the next stop with the buttons Nästa, Upprepa and Avsluta that you can use from inside Google Maps.
Allow the app to ignore battery optimization so the system does not stop it while driving.\n\nOn Samsung also add the app to \"Never sleeping apps\" (see Help).

A floating panel over Google Maps: \"Next\" and \"Back\", the street you are on, the next stop and its time.\n\nTurn on \"Allow display over other apps\" for Nästa Stopp on the next screen. Without it everything works from the notification.
Announcements are always in Swedish so the passengers understand, whatever the app language.

Announcements need Swedish voice data.

Tap "Install", choose Swedish and download it. On Samsung, preferably choose Speech Services by Google as the preferred engine under Text-to-speech.

Then tap "Check again".

The app reads only the remaining time and distance to the next destination from the Google Maps navigation notification, to show them on the passenger display. It reads no notifications of other apps, keeps nothing and sends no position. Tap to allow it in the system settings (notification access).
For the tablet: shows the next destination in large text and connects to the driver\'s device via Bluetooth.
Bluetooth is off – tap to turn on
Pair the phone and the tablet once in Bluetooth settings. Enable this on the driver\'s device, then choose it on the tablet.
Show the street address on the passenger display
The street with the house number is shown large, the area under it. Off = only the area.
Also speak announcements on this device
Map on the tablet (sends the car\'s position)

Off by default. While on and a tablet shows the route, the phone sends the car\'s position and the next stop to the tablet over Bluetooth every 5 seconds. The tablet shows them on a Google map with the way to the next stop, and sends them to Google with your own key (set on the tablet). Nothing is stored or logged. Off: the position never leaves the phone.

Shows a weather app\'s own widget (for example Samsung Weather) in the middle of each minute, in place of SMHI\'s weather. The weather app draws and updates it; this app only shows it. Android asks once whether the app may show widgets.

The map uses your own Google key. In Google Cloud: create an API key, enable "Maps JavaScript API" and "Routes API", and restrict the key to the website https://nastastopp.app/* . Normal use stays within Google\'s free monthly amount. The car\'s position and the next stop go to Google while the map is on (phone setting 209).
Show the way on the map

Shows the phone\'s floating button over the passenger display: the next trip (without the passenger\'s name), a countdown when shrunk, and Next, Back and Repeat for the phone. The street and speed stay on the phone. Needs the permission to show over other apps on this tablet.
No paired devices. Pair the devices in Bluetooth settings first.
Show the floating button during the route

1. Install the app on the tablet too.
2. Pair the phone and the tablet once in Bluetooth settings.
3. On the driver's device: Settings → "Passenger display via Bluetooth" → on.
4. On the tablet: choose "Passenger display", then the driver's device in the list.
5. When the route starts, the tablet shows the next stop in large text, the clock and the following trips below. The tablet speaks each announcement when you tap Next on the phone, and "Lyssna" repeats it.
The link is direct Bluetooth between the devices, no internet. The passenger display can also be opened on the phone itself from the route screen.
Automatic – finds the driver\'s device among paired devices
On the tablet: open Nästa Stopp and choose \"Passenger display\" – it finds this device automatically. Leave this off on the tablet.
Hidden – switch on to show it
Needs \"Display over other apps\" – tap to allow
On Samsung, if the switch is greyed out: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then turn it on.
Floating button closed. Bring it back from the notification, the Quick Settings tile or the app.
Each trip is deleted automatically after %1$s (can be changed in Settings).
Delete all previous trips from the phone?
The street you are on now
Say the next stop\'s street and number
There is no previous trip to go back to
Tap here to bring it back
Add the \"Floating button\" tile to Quick Settings
Tile added – pull down the notification shade to find it
To bring the button back quickly after closing it: tap the \"Floating button closed\" notification, the Quick Settings tile, or this switch.
The explanations behind the small ? and in Help are shown in Arabic; the buttons stay in the app language. Turn off when set-up is finished.
A small translucent number on every button, switch and piece of information (in the app and on the floating button), so you can refer to it by number. The full list is in the README.

When switched on in Settings (105), every button, switch and piece of information has a small number just above it (on small icon buttons: in their corner). To ask for a change, just give the number, e.g. "change 78".
• 1–19: the floating button.
• 20–39: Home.
• 40–60: review list.
• 61–85: route screen.
• 86–95: passenger display.
• 100–139: Settings.
• 140–159: YouDrive.
• 160–179: help and voice.
• 180–190: first start.
• 191–199: tablet as passenger display.
The numbers are hidden by default.

1. On Home tap the "YouDrive" card (25).
2. Log in to YouDrive inside the app once (BankID or password) and open the trips page.
3. Tap the bell (142) to switch on watching; it turns green.
If another page shows instead of the login (e.g. Settings), tap the home button (153) or the phone's Back key. "Add all trips", "Check now" and "Log out" are in the ⋮ menu (155).
The app reads the page every minute (times and addresses only, no names) and reloads it every 5 minutes (only while its window is closed, never while you use it). When a trip is added or cancelled you get a notification with sound and vibration, also while Maps is in front. Tap it and choose "Add to list" or "Remove from list" to update the route.
A trip that disappears more than 5 minutes after its time counts as done, not cancelled. If you open another day or view in YouDrive, it is taken as a new list and no alert is given.
If YouDrive logs you out, the card and the notification say so; open the page and log in again.
No trips on the page · checked %1$s
Logged out – tap the home button (153) and log in
The YouDrive login and everything the page stored are deleted from this phone.
All trips are already in the list
That trip is not in the list
The start point (YouDrive’s Pull-out) is where your day begins. It is shown in grey above the trips, but it is not a stop: it is not sent to Maps, announced or counted.
Automatic – follows the phone’s dark mode

Day is light, in YouDrive’s colours. Night is dark and easy on the eyes when driving in the dark; the trips keep their meanings (green pick-up, grey start, yellow for what to do now). Automatic follows the phone’s dark mode, which Samsung can switch on from sunset to sunrise.

YouDrive forgets its login whenever its window is closed (in Chrome too). With this on, the app presses Login by itself when YouDrive shows its login form: with what YouDrive\'s own \"Remember me\" filled in, or with the login you saved on this phone below. It tries twice at most, so a wrong password never locks your account, and after \"Log out\" it waits until you have signed in yourself.
Not saved: YouDrive\'s own \"Remember me\" is used
Kept only on this phone, encrypted with the phone\'s own key, never backed up or sent anywhere. It is only filled into YouDrive\'s own login form.
Automatic sign-in did not work. Check the login saved in Settings, or sign in yourself.
Saying the street when it changes: on (tap to turn off)
Saying the street when it changes: off (tap to turn on)
Say the street when it changes

During a route, with location allowed, the app says the name of each new street you turn into (after any announcement, never over it). The speaker button on the floating panel turns this on and off quickly. A tap on the panel\'s street bar always says it.
Approximate only: street names need precise location. Tap to allow it.

To name the street you are on exactly, the app matches your GPS position to the roads of Värmland from OpenStreetMap, downloaded once to this phone (© OpenStreetMap contributors). The download asks for the whole region, never your position, and is kept on the phone only, not in the app; Wi-Fi is best. Without the map, the street comes from the nearest address and is shown only when that address is very close, so it may be missing but not wrong.
Not downloaded: tap to download it (once, over the internet)
Downloading… part %1$d of %2$d · the server is busy, waiting
The download stopped at part %1$d of %2$d: tap to continue
